Key size disclosed: ~$20.0B
Use of proceeds: Use of Proceeds and Pricing The proceeds of loans under the Facilities, and letters of credit issued under the Five-Year Revolving Facility, may be used for general corporate purposes or for any other purpose not otherwise prohibited by the applicable Credit Agreement.
Items filed: Item 1: 01 Entry Into a Material Definitive Agreement; Item 1: 02 Termination of a Material Definitive Agreement; Item 2: 03 Creation of a Direct Financial Obligation or an Obligation Under an Off-Balance Sheet Arrangement of a Registrant
engineer: Read the exhibit for operational detail (contracts, launches, compute). 8-K body is often legal wrapper; Exhibit 99.1 carries the substance.
trader:
Map filing to next dated catalyst on the calendar before sizing risk.
Next dated supply/demand events on our calendar:
  • 2026-12-08: Remainder lock-up release (180-day customary expiry)
  • 2027-06-16: Musk block unlock (~6.4B shares, largest tranche)
  • 2027-09-02: Goldman bridge maturity cliff (~$11.4B remaining)
cfa: Treat as corporate finance or governance signal until quantified in financials.
elon: Issuer filing: affects TSLA capital structure and governance, not necessarily Musk's personal sales today. Cross-check CIK 1494730 Form 4 stream for his moves.
